text: Low safety risk and a good fit for calm bedtime reading. Content conditions: a refrain must not be a prohibition or shaming line said to the child character by an adult ('you are too young') or a blame line repeated as the hook, since repetition is what the child imitates and internalises; prefer joinable, positive or neutral lines. Refrains still pass banned_phrase and ceiling checks. Evaluation via completion/reread aggregates needs no new data.
